inlines.v: BROAD-CAST, noun [broad and cast.] Among farmers, a casting or throwing seed from the hand for dispersion in sowing. BROAD-CAST, adverb By scattering or throwing at large from the hand; as, to sow broad-cast BROAD-CAST, adjective Cast or dispersed upon the ground with the hand, as seed in sowing; opposed to planting in hills or rows.
